notes.title: Version 1.3 released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A small-ish patch has been released with the main focus of fixing some issues and better supporting cloud gaming. The changes are:

 Game progress is now more neatly saved with Steam cloud.
 All the necessary settings can now be synced with Steam.
 "Got all points" label now shows the picked up points and total points at the end screen.
 Added a 2-second splash screen at the start of the game.
 Fixed some issues with text fields using decimal points.
 Fixed points not properly resetting when restarting a level.
 Fixed level editor music not stopping when you exit the window.
 Fixed issues with camera movement and V-sync.
 Removed Discord integration.


This update also removed support for 32-bit Linux and OSX. Sorry about that, but it's just how it goes as we're going forward.

This will most likely be the last ever update for real. It was mostly just to fix some stuff with cloud gaming. But as always, if you find any issues, please tell me in the bugs section in the discussions! :)

notes.title: Version 1.2.2 released!
notes.notes:
Hello!

This update took an embarrassingly long time to get out. I just encountered problem after problem, but it's finally here!

Here are the changes:

 Added the ability to unlock the cursor.
 Greatly improved the leaderboards. You can now see more players, around you, and friends only.
 Fixed a bug with the ticking sound.
 Fixed the music starting to play at max volume in the main menu.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 released!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

I've released a new update that should be automatically applied to your game! 

The changes are:

Added controls remapping
Added missing text about rotating in level editor help
Added jump help message in first jump level
Small performance improvements
Fixed being able to respawn while paused
Fixed being able to jump while paused
Fixed the pause menu disappearing if you spammed the back button
Fixed the player being able to double jump
 

If you find any issues, please make a thread in the discussions section!

Thanks, and have fun!
